sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
notes: Part of the same 8-property Offbeat document, but structurally a beach property, not a safari camp - different meal plan/inclusions pattern (no conservancy fees, has watersports and Lamu excursions instead).
Wholesale discount here is 20% (not 30% like the inland Offbeat safari properties) - confirmed arithmetically (Regular Beachfront 2pax: $315 = $394 x 0.80).
Regular season minimum stay 2 nights; High season (20 Dec-10 Jan) minimum stay 5 nights, and Beachfront/Ocean View 4pax categories require minimum 3 adults in High season.

Room names: Beachfront Cabana (2 pax) = Aloha (Twin/Double), Moana (Double), Lokahi (Double). Beachfront Cabana (4 pax) = Makai (1 Twin & 1 Double). Ocean View Cabana (4 pax) = Malama, Ohana (1 Twin & 1 Double each).

beachfrontCabana4pax_Makai.note: Sold as 3 adults minimum in High Season

oceanViewCabana4pax_MalamaOhana.note: Sold as 3 adults minimum in High Season

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
